summary:
Comprehensive architectural implementation plan to align the Membership Members screen 1:1 with members2_reference.html:
1. Root cause diagnosis explaining why the chevron button and detail drawer were previously misplaced.
2. Architecture for the shared single-loop frame-based spring engine (Sp, frame, wake, auto-parking, reduced motion) driving coordinates, heights, and rotations.
3. 1:1 restoration of the 72px island row (.ri, .slab, .in) with the chevron button (.rb) locked at the extreme right (right: 14px) and 3 kinetic hover fan buttons (.act) sliding out to the left.
4. Correct placement and styling of the expanded detail drawer (.dt) at top: 80px, height: 150px with a pure card background and full action column (.db) housing both prototype and secondary operations (Freeze, Pin, Pay).
5. Spring-driven row push physics (H=72px, G=8px, DH=150px) where expanding a drawer smoothly pushes rows below down without layout thrashing.
